definitions.explanation: The state of peace and order in a society, maintained through law enforcement and social stability. Refers to the overall safety and security of a region or community.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{治安|ちあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This area has good public safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{治安|ちあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}している→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Public safety at night has worsened, so please be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{治安|ちあん}⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巡回|じゅんかい}→巡回：12407_junkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}した→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: The police increased patrols to maintain public safety in the area.

notes:
USAGE:
{治安|ちあん} is the standard word for discussing the safety and security of an area. The most common patterns are {治安|ちあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (safe area) and {治安|ちあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (unsafe area). This is one of the first words travelers and residents learn for evaluating neighborhoods. Japan is often described as a country with excellent {治安|ちあん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {治安|ちあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: safe, good public order
- {治安|ちあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: unsafe, poor public order
- {治安|ちあん}⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧: maintenance of public order
- {治安|ちあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧: public safety deteriorates
- {治安|ちあん}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: security measures
- {治安|ちあん}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧: security forces
